cash_movements_refund_ck.name: cash_movements_refund_ck
cash_movements_refund_ck.value: ("cash_movements"."kind" = 'refund') = ("cash_movements"."sale_id" is not null and "cash_movements"."payment_kind" is not null)

cash_sessions_closed_ck.name: cash_sessions_closed_ck
cash_sessions_closed_ck.value:
("cash_sessions"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null and "cash_sessions"."closed_by" is not null
        and "cash_sessions"."expected_cash" is not null and "cash_sessions"."counted_cash" is not null)

clinical_events_status_ck.name: clinical_events_status_ck
clinical_events_status_ck.value:
("clinical_events"."status" = 'draft' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_events"."status" = 'published' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is not null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_events"."status" = 'voided' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is not null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is not null
            and "clinical_events"."void_reason" is not null)

clinical_exam_values_ck.name: clinical_exam_values_ck
clinical_exam_values_ck.value:
("clinical_exam_values"."data_type" = 'text' and "clinical_exam_values"."text_value" is not null and "clinical_exam_values"."numeric_value" is null
          and "clinical_exam_values"."flag" is null)
        or ("clinical_exam_values"."data_type" <> 'text' and "clinical_exam_values"."numeric_value" is not null and "clinical_exam_values"."text_value" is null)

clinical_vitals_ranges_ck.name: clinical_vitals_ranges_ck
clinical_vitals_ranges_ck.value:
("clinical_vitals"."heart_rate" is null or "clinical_vitals"."heart_rate" between 10 and 400)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."respiratory_rate" is null or "clinical_vitals"."respiratory_rate" between 4 and 200)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."temperature" is null or "clinical_vitals"."temperature" between 30 and 45)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."capillary_refill" is null or "clinical_vitals"."capillary_refill" between 0 and 10)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."weight_kg" is null or "clinical_vitals"."weight_kg" between 0.001 and 2000)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."body_score" is null or "clinical_vitals"."body_score" between 1 and 9)

commission_statements_ck.name: commission_statements_ck
commission_statements_ck.value:
("commission_statements"."status" in ('open', 'review') or ("commission_statements"."closed_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."due_date" is not null and "commission_statements"."total" > 0))
        and (("commission_statements"."status" in ('paid', 'archived')) = ("commission_statements"."paid_on" is not null))

exam_attributes_type_ck.name: exam_attributes_type_ck
exam_attributes_type_ck.value:
("exam_attributes"."kind" = 'section' and "exam_attributes"."data_type" is null)
        or ("exam_attributes"."kind" = 'field' and "exam_attributes"."data_type" is not null
          and ("exam_attributes"."data_type" <> 'decimal' or "exam_attributes"."decimals" between 0 and 4)
          and ("exam_attributes"."data_type" <> 'text' or "exam_attributes"."max_length" between 1 and 200))

exam_reference_ranges_ck.name: exam_reference_ranges_ck
exam_reference_ranges_ck.value:
("exam_reference_ranges"."low" is not null or "exam_reference_ranges"."high" is not null)
        and ("exam_reference_ranges"."low" is null or "exam_reference_ranges"."high" is null or "exam_reference_ranges"."low" <= "exam_reference_ranges"."high")

financial_entries_paid_ck.name: financial_entries_paid_ck
financial_entries_paid_ck.value:
("financial_entries"."status" <> 'paid' or ("financial_entries"."paid_on" is not null and "financial_entries"."paid_amount" is not null))
        and ("financial_entries"."status" <> 'open' or ("financial_entries"."paid_on" is null and "financial_entries"."paid_amount" is null))

financial_entries_kind_ck.name: financial_entries_kind_ck
financial_entries_kind_ck.value:
("financial_entries"."kind" = 'transfer') = ("financial_entries"."transfer_id" is not null)
        and ("financial_entries"."kind" = 'transfer' or "financial_entries"."category_id" is not null)
        and ("financial_entries"."kind" <> 'income' or "financial_entries"."direction" = 'in')
        and ("financial_entries"."kind" <> 'expense' or "financial_entries"."direction" = 'out')

financial_entries_installment_ck.name: financial_entries_installment_ck
financial_entries_installment_ck.value:
("financial_entries"."installment_number" is null) = ("financial_entries"."installment_total" is null)
        and ("financial_entries"."installment_number" is null or "financial_entries"."installment_number" between 1 and "financial_entries"."installment_total")

hospitalization_entries_weight_ck.name: hospitalization_entries_weight_ck
hospitalization_entries_weight_ck.value:
("hospitalization_entries"."kind" = 'weight') = ("hospitalization_entries"."weight_kg" is not null)
        and ("hospitalization_entries"."weight_kg" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."weight_kg" between 0.001 and 2000)

hospitalization_entries_numbers_ck.name: hospitalization_entries_numbers_ck
hospitalization_entries_numbers_ck.value:
("hospitalization_entries"."heart_rate" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."heart_rate" between 10 and 400)
        and ("hospitalization_entries"."respiratory_rate" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."respiratory_rate" between 4 and 200)
        and ("hospitalization_entries"."systolic_pressure" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."systolic_pressure" between 20 and 350)
        and ("hospitalization_entries"."glucose" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."glucose" between 10 and 1500)
        and ("hospitalization_entries"."dehydration" is null or "hospitalization_entries"."dehydration" between 0 and 15)

hospitalization_prescriptions_ck.name: hospitalization_prescriptions_ck
hospitalization_prescriptions_ck.value:
"hospitalization_prescriptions"."dose" > 0 and "hospitalization_prescriptions"."interval_hours" between 1 and 72
        and ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."duration_days" is null or "hospitalization_prescriptions"."duration_days" between 1 and 90)
        and ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."concentration" is null or "hospitalization_prescriptions"."concentration" > 0)
        and ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."stopped_at" is null) = ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."stopped_by" is null)
        and ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."stopped_at" is null) = ("hospitalization_prescriptions"."stop_reason" is null)

hospitalizations_end_ck.name: hospitalizations_end_ck
hospitalizations_end_ck.value:
("hospitalizations"."status" = 'admitted') = ("hospitalizations"."ended_at" is null)
        and ("hospitalizations"."ended_at" is null) = ("hospitalizations"."ended_by" is null)
        and ("hospitalizations"."status" <> 'admitted' or "hospitalizations"."outcome_notes" is null)
        and ("hospitalizations"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "hospitalizations"."outcome_notes" is not null)

messages_status_ck.name: messages_status_ck
messages_status_ck.value:
("messages"."status" = 'skipped') = ("messages"."skip_reason" is not null)
        and ("messages"."status" = 'sent') = ("messages"."sent_at" is not null and "messages"."channel" is not null)

package_usages_undo_ck.name: package_usages_undo_ck
package_usages_undo_ck.value: ("package_usages"."undone_at" is null) = ("package_usages"."undone_by" is null) and ("package_usages"."undone_at" is null) = ("package_usages"."undo_reason" is null)

payment_methods_values_ck.name: payment_methods_values_ck
payment_methods_values_ck.value:
"payment_methods"."settlement_days" between 0 and 365 and "payment_methods"."max_installments" between 1 and 24
        and "payment_methods"."fee_percent" between 0 and 30
        and ("payment_methods"."max_installments" = 1 or "payment_methods"."kind" in ('credit', 'voucher'))
        and ("payment_methods"."kind" <> 'account' or "payment_methods"."fee_percent" = 0)

products_package_ck.name: products_package_ck
products_package_ck.value:
("products"."service_kind" = 'package') = ("products"."package_service_id" is not null)
        and ("products"."package_service_id" is null) = ("products"."package_sessions" is null)
        and ("products"."package_sessions" is null or "products"."package_sessions" between 2 and 100)
        and ("products"."package_validity_days" is null or ("products"."package_service_id" is not null
          and "products"."package_validity_days" between 1 and 1095))

products_kind_ck.name: products_kind_ck
products_kind_ck.value:
("products"."kind" = 'product' and "products"."service_kind" is null and "products"."municipal_service_code" is null)
        or ("products"."kind" = 'service' and "products"."service_kind" is not null and "products"."ncm" is null
          and "products"."barcode" is null and not "products"."tracks_stock")

products_values_ck.name: products_values_ck
products_values_ck.value:
"products"."sale_price" >= 0 and ("products"."cost" is null or "products"."cost" >= 0)
        and ("products"."desired_markup" is null or "products"."desired_markup" >= 0)
        and ("products"."discount_limit_percent" is null or "products"."discount_limit_percent" between 0 and 100)
        and "products"."default_commission_percent" between 0 and 100
        and ("products"."min_stock" is null or "products"."min_stock" >= 0)
        and ("products"."ideal_stock" is null or "products"."ideal_stock" >= 0)
        and (not "products"."tracks_lots" or "products"."tracks_stock")

purchase_items_values_ck.name: purchase_items_values_ck
purchase_items_values_ck.value:
"purchase_items"."quantity" > 0 and "purchase_items"."factor" > 0 and "purchase_items"."total" >= 0
        and ("purchase_items"."lot_code" is null) = ("purchase_items"."expires_on" is null)

purchase_orders_ck.name: purchase_orders_ck
purchase_orders_ck.value:
"purchase_orders"."total" >= 0
        and ("purchase_orders"."status" not in ('sent', 'received') or "purchase_orders"."sent_at" is not null)
        and ("purchase_orders"."status" <> 'received' or ("purchase_orders"."received_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."purchase_id" is not null))
        and ("purchase_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."cancel_reason" is not null))

purchases_status_ck.name: purchases_status_ck
purchases_status_ck.value:
("purchases"."status" <> 'confirmed' or "purchases"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        and ("purchases"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("purchases"."cancelled_at" is not null and "purchases"."cancel_reason" is not null))

sale_items_values_ck.name: sale_items_values_ck
sale_items_values_ck.value:
"sale_items"."quantity" > 0 and "sale_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "sale_items"."list_price" >= 0
        and "sale_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "sale_items"."discount_amount" <= "sale_items"."gross_total"
        and "sale_items"."net_total" = "sale_items"."gross_total" - "sale_items"."discount_amount"
        and "sale_items"."commission_percent" between 0 and 100

sale_payments_values_ck.name: sale_payments_values_ck
sale_payments_values_ck.value: "sale_payments"."amount" > 0 and "sale_payments"."installments" between 1 and 24 and "sale_payments"."fee_percent" between 0 and 30

sales_patient_client_ck.name: sales_patient_client_ck
sales_patient_client_ck.value: "sales"."patient_id" is null or "sales"."client_id" is not null

sales_closed_ck.name: sales_closed_ck
sales_closed_ck.value:
("sales"."closed_at" is null) = ("sales"."closed_by" is null)
        and ("sales"."status" <> 'closed' or "sales"."closed_at" is not null)
        and ("sales"."status" not in ('quote', 'open') or "sales"."closed_at" is null)

sales_sold_ck.name: sales_sold_ck
sales_sold_ck.value:
("sales"."status" <> 'quote' or "sales"."sold_at" is null)
        and ("sales"."status" not in ('open', 'closed') or "sales"."sold_at" is not null)

sales_cancel_ck.name: sales_cancel_ck
sales_cancel_ck.value: ("sales"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("sales"."cancelled_at" is not null and "sales"."cancel_reason" is not null)

stock_movements_ck.name: stock_movements_ck
stock_movements_ck.value:
"stock_movements"."on_hand_after" >= 0 and "stock_movements"."shortfall" >= 0 and "stock_movements"."shortfall_after" >= 0
        and ("stock_movements"."kind" not in ('sale', 'sale_return') or "stock_movements"."sale_id" is not null)
        and ("stock_movements"."kind" not in ('purchase', 'purchase_cancel') or "stock_movements"."purchase_id" is not null)
        and ("stock_movements"."kind" not in ('exit', 'exit_cancel') or "stock_movements"."exit_id" is not null)
        and ("stock_movements"."kind" not in ('sale', 'purchase_cancel', 'exit') or "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        and ("stock_movements"."kind" not in ('entry', 'sale_return', 'purchase', 'exit_cancel') or "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)

vaccines_doses_ck.name: vaccines_doses_ck
vaccines_doses_ck.value:
"vaccines"."primary_doses" between 1 and 6
        and ("vaccines"."primary_doses" = 1 or "vaccines"."primary_interval_days" is not null)
        and ("vaccines"."primary_interval_days" is null or "vaccines"."primary_interval_days" between 1 and 1095)
        and ("vaccines"."booster_interval_days" is null or "vaccines"."booster_interval_days" between 1 and 1095)
